entries.context: Don't believe his promises, he talks big but does nothing.

entries.vietlish: I want to open a bank account but no time to go
entries.natural: I want to open a bank account but I have no time to go
entries.sourcePattern: khong co thoi gian -> dropped subject and verb after but
entries.context: Maybe next week, I want to open a bank account but no time to go.

entries.vietlish: she is younger than me but more mature
entries.natural: she is younger than me but more mature
entries.sourcePattern: chin chan hon -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: I admire her, she is younger than me but more mature.

entries.vietlish: I get used with the new job slowly
entries.natural: I'm getting used to the new job slowly
entries.sourcePattern: quen voi -> with for to after get used
entries.context: It was hard at first, but I get used with the new job slowly.

entries.vietlish: the rice field is green, very beautiful in my eyes
entries.natural: the rice fields are green, very beautiful to my eyes
entries.sourcePattern: trong mat toi -> in my eyes calque plus field no plural
entries.context: Coming home, the rice field is green, very beautiful in my eyes.

entries.vietlish: he failed the test but he is not sad, strange
entries.natural: he failed the test but he isn't sad, which is strange
entries.sourcePattern: la that -> dropped relative plus comment word
entries.context: I worry about him, he failed the test but he is not sad, strange.

entries.vietlish: please give me back when you finish reading
entries.natural: please give it back to me when you finish reading
entries.sourcePattern: tra lai khi nao xong -> dropped object and to-phrase
entries.context: You can borrow my book, please give me back when you finish reading.

entries.vietlish: she cried a river when she heard the news
entries.natural: she cried a lot when she heard the news
entries.sourcePattern: khoc nhu mua -> cry a river calque for cry a lot
entries.context: It was very sad, she cried a river when she heard the news.

entries.vietlish: I have to save face in front of my friends
entries.natural: I have to save face in front of my friends
entries.sourcePattern: giu the dien -> idiom calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: I could not say no, I have to save face in front of my friends.

entries.vietlish: the bus is so full, I stand all the way
entries.natural: the bus was so full that I stood the whole way
entries.sourcePattern: dung suot -> so...that reduced plus no past plus all the way
entries.context: This morning the bus is so full, I stand all the way to work.

entries.vietlish: he is the breadwinner, the whole family depends him
entries.natural: he is the breadwinner, the whole family depends on him
entries.sourcePattern: phu thuoc vao -> on dropped after depend
entries.context: His job is important, he is the breadwinner, the whole family depends him.

entries.vietlish: she goes to the temple to burn incense
entries.natural: she goes to the temple to burn incense
entries.sourcePattern: thap huong -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: On the first day of the month she goes to the temple to burn incense.

entries.vietlish: the old house is selling, do you want to see
entries.natural: the old house is for sale, do you want to see it
entries.sourcePattern: dang ban -> is selling for is for sale plus dropped object
entries.context: Good location, the old house is selling, do you want to see?

entries.vietlish: I will repair the roof before the rainy season comes
entries.natural: I'll repair the roof before the rainy season comes
entries.sourcePattern: mua mua -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: The leak is getting worse, I will repair the roof before the rainy season comes.

entries.vietlish: she is in the period of looking for a job
entries.natural: she is in the middle of looking for a job
entries.sourcePattern: trong giai doan -> period for the middle phase
entries.context: Please be patient with her, she is in the period of looking for a job.

entries.vietlish: the kids are growing, the clothes are short already
entries.natural: the kids are growing, their clothes are too small already
entries.sourcePattern: do ngan roi -> short for too small with clothes
entries.context: I must buy new ones, the kids are growing, the clothes are short already.

entries.vietlish: he came back from abroad with a lot of experience
entries.natural: he came back from abroad with a lot of experience
entries.sourcePattern: ve nuoc -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: Now he is a manager, he came back from abroad with a lot of experience.

entries.vietlish: I will pay back you next month, I promise
entries.natural: I'll pay you back next month, I promise
entries.sourcePattern: tra lai ban -> particle back before the object
entries.context: Thank you for helping me, I will pay back you next month, I promise.

entries.vietlish: she sings on the stage, everybody claps her
entries.natural: she sings on the stage and everybody claps for her
entries.sourcePattern: vo tay cho -> clap with a direct object instead of for
entries.context: She is talented, she sings on the stage, everybody claps her.

entries.vietlish: I tried my best but the result is not as I expect
entries.natural: I tried my best but the result wasn't what I expected
entries.sourcePattern: khong nhu mong doi -> as for what plus present for past
entries.context: It is disappointing, I tried my best but the result is not as I expect.

entries.vietlish: the medicine is bitter but it is good for health
entries.natural: the medicine is bitter but it's good for your health
entries.sourcePattern: tot cho suc khoe -> your dropped before health
entries.context: Drink it all, the medicine is bitter but it is good for health.

entries.vietlish: I am worried for my son, he plays too much game
entries.natural: I'm worried about my son, he plays too many games
entries.sourcePattern: lo cho con -> for instead of about plus game no plural
entries.context: He doesn't study, I am worried for my son, he plays too much game.

entries.vietlish: she dresses very beautiful to go to the party
entries.natural: she dressed very beautifully to go to the party
entries.sourcePattern: mac dep -> adjective for adverb plus no past
entries.context: Everyone looked at her, she dresses very beautiful to go to the party.

entries.vietlish: he is the youngest but the most clever in the family
entries.natural: he is the youngest but the cleverest in the family
entries.sourcePattern: thong minh nhat -> most + clever instead of cleverest
entries.context: Everyone agrees, he is the youngest but the most clever in the family.

entries.vietlish: I want to thank to my parents for everything
entries.natural: I want to thank my parents for everything
entries.sourcePattern: cam on bo me -> extra to after thank
entries.context: In my speech, I want to thank to my parents for everything.

entries.vietlish: the festival is very lively, many games and food
entries.natural: the festival is very lively, with many games and lots of food
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu tro choi va do an -> dropped with plus food no quantifier
entries.context: Come with us, the festival is very lively, many games and food.

entries.vietlish: she keeps her promise, I trust her absolutely
entries.natural: she keeps her promises, I trust her completely
entries.sourcePattern: giu loi hua -> promise no plural plus absolutely for completely
entries.context: You can count on her, she keeps her promise, I trust her absolutely.

entries.vietlish: I am studying English by myself at home
entries.natural: I'm studying English by myself at home
entries.sourcePattern: tu hoc o nha -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: I cannot afford a class, I am studying English by myself at home.

entries.vietlish: the shop assistant followed me everywhere, annoying
entries.natural: the shop assistant followed me everywhere, which was annoying
entries.sourcePattern: kho chiu -> dropped relative and be before annoying
entries.context: I left quickly, the shop assistant followed me everywhere, annoying.

entries.vietlish: she works in a factory far from home, very hard
entries.natural: she works in a factory far from home, it's very hard
entries.sourcePattern: vat va lam -> dropped dummy subject and be before hard
entries.context: She sends money every month, she works in a factory far from home, very hard.

entries.vietlish: he asked me to lend him until end of month
entries.natural: he asked me to lend him money until the end of the month
entries.sourcePattern: cho muon den cuoi thang -> dropped object plus article
entries.context: I felt sorry for him, he asked me to lend him until end of month.

entries.vietlish: she scolded her son for play truant
entries.natural: she scolded her son for playing truant
entries.sourcePattern: mang con vi tron hoc -> for + base verb instead of gerund
entries.context: The teacher called home, she scolded her son for play truant.
